purpose: Production decorative illustrations for actual single-screen game catalogues; all inventory, labels and actions stay in DOM.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent illustration for a Chinese xianxia game's inventory page. Primary request: a carefully painted still life of an ancient dark-teal silk travel pouch, a small cluster of pale cyan spiritual crystals, two stems of dew-covered medicinal herbs, and a restrained cloudlike ink wash at the base. This is a decorative category illustration, not a grid of icons or a UI mockup. Style: polished new Chinese fantasy semi-realistic painting, fine brush texture, natural materials, atmospheric edges, consistent with a misty mountain cultivation game. Palette: qingdai deep blue-green and ink green, muted jade highlights, sparse aged-gold fittings, no yellow background. Composition: one coherent centered object group in a square canvas, all items fully visible with generous clear margins, readable silhouette at 250px. Lighting: soft cool mountain light with subtle warm gold reflections. Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no white/colored rectangle or checkerboard. No characters, no text, no writing, no labels, no numbers, no border, no UI, no watermark. Preserve clean translucent edges and fine leaf details.
